mapper.insert: INSERT INTO speech_ai_feedback(analysis_id, feedback_text, evidence_hash, model_name, prompt_version, sources_json) VALUES(#{analysisId}, #{text}, #{evidenceHash}, #{modelName}, #{promptVersion}, #{sourcesJson}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE feedback_text = VALUES(feedback_text), evidence_hash = VALUES(evidence_hash), model_name = VALUES(model_name), prompt_version = VALUES(prompt_version), sources_json = VALUES(sources_json)
